observed_behavior: Campaign census columns shifted between rows when plan or sprint identifiers crossed different terminal tab stops.
expected_behavior: Every human-readable census table keeps the same column boundaries for every row, including rows with long identifiers.
causal_mechanism: The renderer separated fields with tab characters, whose displayed width depends on the preceding field length and the consumer's tab-stop configuration.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A tabular text renderer delegates column placement to tab expansion instead of deriving widths from the complete table.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Rows whose fields end in different tab-stop intervals advance to different next columns, so subsequent values no longer share a boundary.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Each rendered column begins at one table-derived position for every row.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Compute each column's maximum content width, pad text fields to that width, right-align numeric cells, and join columns with fixed spaces.

applicability_conditions: A human-readable terminal table contains variable-length fields.
The output must remain aligned independently of terminal tab expansion.
known_non_matches: Machine-readable JSON output, which has no visual column-alignment contract.
confirmation_evidence: The failing report contained literal tab separators, and rows with longer plan identifiers displayed later counts at different tab stops.
Replacing tabs with widths derived from all rows aligned the supplied long-identifier shape without changing census values.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-census-format.test.js: human report aligns census columns after long identifiers
tests/campaign-census.test.js: production module uses exact exit and stream contracts without mutation
